title: On lower bounds for the number of ideal and finite vertices of right-angled hyperbolic polyhedra in dimensions from 5 to 12
summary: We investigate lower bounds for the number of ideal and finite vertices of right-angled hyperbolic polyhedra of finite volume. We use a geometric method of orthogonal gluings to establish new bounds in low dimensions, specifically $v_\infty(P^5) \ge 3$ and $v_{fin}(P^7) \ge 4$. By combining these initial bounds with double counting arguments and recurrence relations, we obtain improved lower bounds for both types of vertices in all higher dimensions up to $n=12$, the maximal dimension where polyhedra of this class exist.
